query:
SELECT 
  slug,
  title,
  discipline,
  seoKeywords,
  LENGTH(seoKeywords) - LENGTH(REPLACE(seoKeywords, ',', '')) + 1 as keyword_count,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(excerpt, '')) as description_length
FROM projects 
WHERE status = 'published'
ORDER BY discipline, title;
